mutant.description: Call-order mutant in app/schwab_audit.py release(): the data producer is called BEFORE the acknowledged PutObject (inserted `_early = produce()` ahead of `await acknowledge(...)`). AC1 and AC2 run against the mutant; the file was then restored and its sha256 compared.
mutant.expected: test_ogo1_ac01 fails on the order assertion and test_ogo1_ac02 fails on the no-data-without-receipt assertion.
mutant.observed: mutant rc=1, '2 failed in 1.28s'; AC1: AssertionError [('data_released', None), ('put_object_acked', 200), ('data_released', None)]; AC2: AssertionError at test_schwab_audit.py:122. Restored: sha256 911b682e8f84dba5148c2b0bf59eca5d9cd01b5be1b6efe68cd29ca75b37dcd5 before and after, 0 MUTANT lines.

declared_exclusions.item: Wiring the entry point into the Schwab tools and download routes.
declared_exclusions.reason: Owned by OG-q-2 (OGQ2-AC23: every tool call writes its audit event through OG-o-1 before release) and OG-x-1; this order's paths are the module and its test only.

declared_exclusions.item: Any deploy, IAM or Terraform change.
declared_exclusions.reason: The order says nothing deploys, and the prefix sits inside the existing audit/* PutObject grant (AC7).

declared_exclusions.item: Automatic delivery_finished / cancelled / failed records after a release.
declared_exclusions.reason: release() gates the release on the release_authorized receipt; the post-release events are recorded by the caller through record_event(), because only the caller knows what was actually delivered. Stated in the module docstring.

declared_exclusions.item: infra/aws/ec2/opal-gateway/audit.jsonl modified in this worktree, not committed.
declared_exclusions.reason: Side effect of a voluntary regression run of the existing Gateway suite from its own directory (test_ratelimit writes 3 _ratelimit_control lines at 10:38:12Z through audit.log_call to the cwd-relative ./audit.jsonl). The file is outside this order's grant, so it is neither committed nor edited back; the seven criteria run from the workspace root and write nothing there.

surprises: NFRA_OPLGTW-W5-S1: the PRD's audit fields name 'master' in the same sentence that excludes raw account IDs, and the contract's masters are 8-digit account-number-shaped codes; OG-o-1 records master as given, bounded to the contract's two keys (OBSERVATION, INERT).
